summary: Core part price should not appear as $0 under the header "Rate".
reported_issue: Request-order-receive a special order part on a line with a core price set. Before pressing OK/Not OK (review), the Core price appears as $0 under the header "Rate", which is wrong.
expected_after_fix: The Core price under the header "RATE" should show the full core price if the OK/Not OK status is unconfirmed.
steps_i_followed: Located an existing WO with a received special-order core part whose OK/Not OK review is still unconfirmed (WO S9-24399, line 1 'HOD', part '(HOT SPO) Description of part' with core '(HOT SPO) Core for Description of part').
Confirmed via API that the core part_request (is_core_charge=true, status=received) has sell_price=1 and cost=1 (non-zero).
Opened the Lines tab and read the 'Rate' column for the core sub-row while the Ok / Not Ok buttons are still shown (review unconfirmed).
actual_now: The core part still shows Rate $0.00 (and Total $0) in the Lines tab while its OK/Not Ok review is unconfirmed (Ok / Not Ok buttons visible). The parent part '(HOT SPO) Description of part' shows its Rate $40.00 correctly, but the core row '(HOT SPO) Core for Description of part' shows $0.00 under Rate even though the core's actual sell_price is $1 per the API. The core price is therefore NOT shown under Rate before the OK/Not OK confirmation, exactly as reported.
notes: Reproduced with real staging data (WO S9-24399). The core row displays Rate $0.00 while review (Ok/Not Ok) is unconfirmed, contradicting the expected behavior that the full core price should be shown. Regression persists.
